animationPayload.sourceNote: The Derry Journal of 20 September 1946 printed Andrew Gallagher 146 and John Boyle 115. On 23 September it printed the West Ward count again, "not as already reported", with Gallagher on 141, and the Irish Weekly of 28 September gives Gallagher 141 and Boyle 118. Civgraph shows 141 and 118, as the Belfast News-Letter printed them.
